coverage: env -u DB_URL -u DB_USER -u DB_PASSWORD -u SERVER_PORT -u APP_FRONTEND_ORIGIN -u SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE -u APP_SECURITY_SEED_ENABLED -u APP_INITIAL_ADMIN_USERNAME -u APP_INITIAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD -u APP_INITIAL_OPERATOR_USERNAME -u APP_INITIAL_OPERATOR_PASSWORD mvn clean verify
unset_env: unset DB_PASSWORD DB_USER DB_URL SERVER_PORT APP_FRONTEND_ORIGIN APP_SECURITY_SEED_ENABLED APP_INITIAL_ADMIN_USERNAME APP_INITIAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD APP_INITIAL_OPERATOR_USERNAME APP_INITIAL_OPERATOR_PASSWORD SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE
docs:uml: printf '\nJavadoc e UML generati in backend/target/reports/apidocs/\n'
docs:database: docker run --rm --network "$NETWORK" -v "$PWD/docs/generated/schemaspy:/output" schemaspy/schemaspy:7.0.2 -t pgsql -host postgres -port 5432 -db personarum -s public -u "$DB_USER" -p "$DB_PASSWORD"
docs:coverage: env -u DB_URL -u DB_USER -u DB_PASSWORD -u SERVER_PORT -u APP_FRONTEND_ORIGIN -u SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE -u APP_SECURITY_SEED_ENABLED -u APP_INITIAL_ADMIN_USERNAME -u APP_INITIAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD -u APP_INITIAL_OPERATOR_USERNAME -u APP_INITIAL_OPERATOR_PASSWORD mvn clean verify
docs:open:uml: test -f backend/target/reports/apidocs/index.html || { echo 'Documentazione UML non trovata. Esegui: devbox run docs:uml'; exit 1; }
docs:open:doxygen: test -f docs/generated/doxygen/html/index.html || { echo 'Documentazione Doxygen non trovata. Esegui: devbox run docs:doxygen'; exit 1; }
docs:open:database: test -f docs/generated/schemaspy/index.html || { echo 'Documentazione SchemaSpy non trovata. Esegui: devbox run docs:database'; exit 1; }
docs:open:coverage: test -f backend/target/site/jacoco/index.html || { echo 'Report JaCoCo non trovato. Esegui: devbox run docs:coverage'; exit 1; }
docs:open:openapi: test -f docs/generated/openapi/openapi.json || { echo 'OpenAPI non trovata. Esegui: devbox run docs:openapi'; exit 1; }
